## Summary

Describe the focused change and the numbered implementation task or governance
requirement it satisfies.

## Verification

- [ ] I added or updated user-visible/contract tests before implementation when behavior changed.
- [ ] I ran the affected lint, typecheck, test, build, and infrastructure checks.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for secrets, generated output, personal data, and unrelated changes.
- [ ] I documented every new dependency, copied component, asset, and applicable license.

## Contribution and rights

- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution and it contains no unauthorized third-party or confidential material.
- [ ] Every commit includes a `Signed-off-by:` trailer.
- [ ] I understand that accepted contributions are governed by `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the repository remains proprietary.
